spacing_and_layout.grid_dashboard: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-px bg-border/20 border border-border/20

cards.interactive: bg-white border border-strong rounded-none shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)] transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:-translate-x-1 hover:shadow-[6px_6px_0px_0px_rgba(10,10,10,1)]

buttons.primary: bg-strong text-inverse rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-brand-primary transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-primary focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-strong border border-strong rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-muted transition-colors
buttons.danger: bg-brand-accent_red text-inverse rounded-none px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:opacity-90 transition-opacity

inputs.default: rounded-none border-strong focus-visible:ring-0 focus-visible:border-brand-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-0 bg-white

tables.container: border border-strong bg-white w-full text-left border-collapse
tables.header: border-b border-strong bg-muted font-mono text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-secondary py-3 px-4

badges.default: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 border border-strong text-xs font-mono font-medium rounded-none bg-white
badges.active: inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 border border-strong text-xs font-mono font-medium rounded-none bg-brand-accent_green/10 text-brand-strong

visual_enhancers.motion: minimalist micro-interactions, sharp transitions (e.g., transition-transform duration-150 ease-out)
visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use grid gaps as 1px borders via bg-border.
visual_enhancers.effects: No soft shadows. Use solid, hard-edged offset drop shadows for interactive elements if necessary, or strictly flat.

auth_background.description: Abstract geometric architecture, black and white curved facade. Use as background on Auth/Login split-screen.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a strict, Swiss-brutalist styled SaaS dashboard.
Do NOT use soft rounded corners (`rounded-md`, `rounded-lg`). Enforce `rounded-none` globally for cards, buttons, inputs, and modals.
Use a monochrome palette (black, white, grays) for structure, and reserve International Klein Blue (#002FA7) or Signal Red (#FF2A00) exclusively for primary CTAs and critical states.
For the data tables (Access Lists, Connected Emails), use prominent borders and monospace headers. The UI should look technical and 'honest'—exposed structures.
Use Shadcn UI components but override their default rounded styles and subtle shadows with sharp borders (`border-black`) and flat styling.
Ensure the dashboard uses a dense, 'Control Room' grid layout for the overview.
Always apply `data-testid` attributes to all actionable elements.
For fonts, inject Google Fonts: 'Chivo' (400,600,700) for headings, 'IBM Plex Sans' (400,500) for body, and 'IBM Plex Mono' (400,500) for overlines/stats.
